note: PLAN-amendment-0.5.1 section 2. Worked by hand, recomputed by test_tbc_dressed.py (tbc_dressed.numbers). MW m^-2 K^-1. Exploratory, not pre-registered.
inputs: data/read-gaskins2018.json (published Nano Lett. 2018 figure): 490 +107/-111 (300 K), 524 +121/-124 (385 K), 503 +127/-131 (500 K); 95 % bars -> 1 sigma = mean arm / 1.96

reading.profile: channel I = a T/300 plus any non-decreasing elastic part, independent Gaussian errors, Delta chi^2 = 2.71 (approximate one-sided 95 %)
reading.two_point: amendment 0.5's bound with one-sided 95 % on (G500 - G300), errors independent
reading.correlated: errors fully shared between temperatures (common scale): only the reading error remains
reading.crude_floor: a DMM interface whose dressed conductance falls as far as the closed form allows (G_0 fixed, radiation limits grown by the 22 THz heat-capacity ratio, G_d/G_0 = 2); the bound with that falling elastic part, at central published values
